name: NCNPS B.W. Wells Stewardship Fund
summary: Small grants of up to $1,000 for North Carolina organisations managing natural plant communities, installing native plant and pollinator gardens, or running native plant education.

calls.label: Applications due 1 September
calls.recurring: Applications must be received by 1 September; applicants are notified by 1 November of each year.

status.quote: All applications must be received by September 1. Notification will be made to applicants by November 1st of each year.

recurring.quote: All applications must be received by September 1. Notification will be made to applicants by November 1st of each year.

applicant_types.quote: Grants are available to organizations, including federal, state, and local agencies, and local community organizations.

geography.quote: management of natural plant communities in North Carolina, e.g., invasive species control, prescribed burns, erosion control

access.quote: Detailed information and instructions for submitting can be found on the application form.
